description:
About the job




About Us

Dymax, part of the Bachmann Chemical & Engineering family of brands is based out of Torrington, Connecticut. Dymax is globally recognized as a pioneer in the development of light-curable adhesives and curing equipment. Today, our expansive portfolio of innovative adhesives, coatings, and maskants are supported by dispense solutions and cutting-edge UV and LED light-curing equipment. Unlike our competitors who supplying standard products, Dymax focuses on the customer experience by tailoring solutions that help customers lower costs, reduce their carbon footprint, improve efficiency, and drive profitability. Our focus on being a customer intimate organization has led us to where we are today: a rapidly expanding force within our industry, an innovative product portfolio, extraordinary employees, and a bright future based on creating quality offerings with a dedication to business growth.

About You

We're seeking a result-focused, innovative, self-driven, and well-qualified individual to join our talented team as our Engagement & Demand Generation MarCom Specialist. You will execute integrated MarCom activities that generate brand awareness, engagement, and leads by developing and deploying content, campaigns, and promotional assets across digital, social, and event channels, applying established messaging and brand guidelines to deliver consistent, accurate, and effective communications for an assigned brand or portfolio.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Execute integrated marketing communications activities for an assigned brand or portfolio by developing content and campaign materials aligned with established messaging and marketing direction across digital, social, email, web, and event channels
Create multichannel marketing assets that enable effective customer engagement by drafting, designing, editing, and publishing content, including graphics, videos, written materials, presentations, and promotional collateral for use across campaigns and sales enablement efforts
Deliver digital marketing campaigns that build awareness and generate inbound interest by executing activities across web properties, search marketing, social media, and marketing automation platforms in accordance with defined campaign objectives and timelines
Apply market and performance insight to improve marketing execution by monitoring campaign results, engagement metrics, and channel performance, and using insights to refine tactics and improve effectiveness within established frameworks
Coordinate marketing communications schedules and content calendars by planning, maintaining, and adjusting editorial schedules that align day-to-day communications activity with campaign timing, business priorities, and channel-specific delivery requirements
Manage external vendors, agencies, and partners to support marketing execution by coordinating inputs, clarifying requirements, reviewing deliverables for accuracy and quality, and ensuring content is delivered on time and aligned with established brand and campaign expectations
Execute events and promotional activities by coordinating event logistics, stakeholders, materials, messaging, and follow-up activities that reinforce brand presence, enable engagement, and capture participation and lead outcomes for reporting and review


Requirements



You should have: 

BS/BA degree in Communications, Marketing, or equivalency
Experience executing integrated marketing communications or digital marketing activities across multiple channels
Working knowledge of MarCom tools and platforms, including social media, content management systems, marketing automation, and analytics tools
Strong writing, editing, and content development capability with attention to detail and brand consistency
Ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently and apply sound judgment within established marketing direction
This role requires strong English communication skills, including the ability to speak, read, and write clearly and effectively.

 



Benefits



Dymax takes the compensation of its employees very seriously and considers several factors when determining the total compensation package including but not limited to location, market range, skills, knowledge, experience, and abilities. The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Dymax salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and may be above or below the range. The range listed is just one component of Dymax's total compensation packages for employees.


Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in Mexico.


Dymax provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, domestic violence status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Job Description

ABOUT US 

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, we're the world's leading premium drinks company. From global icons like Johnnie Walker, Guinness and Tanqueray to Smirnoff and Don Julio, we create brands consumers love. Bring your passion and use your curiosity as you explore, collaborate and innovate. Together with passionate people from all over the world, you'll test new ideas, learn and grow, and unlock a brighter, more exciting future. Join us to create a career worth celebrating.

Finance at Diageo is about more than the numbers, it's about shaping the decisions behind them. From guiding investment to unlocking growth, this team plays a critical role in how we perform today and how we plan for tomorrow. You'll work with data, insight and digital tools to influence strategy and help drive a business that operates at global scale. It's a fast-moving environment where no two days are the same, and where you'll be supported to build your skills, grow your career and make a real impact.

About This Role

We are looking for a commercially minded and analytically driven Commercial Finance Manager, Marketing & Innovation to partner with our Marketing team and help shape investment decisions that drive sustainable growth across our portfolio. Acting as a trusted business partner, this role provides ongoing financial analysis, business modelling and performance insights to support Strategic Planning, AOP, forecasting and innovation initiatives. Success in this role means providing actionable insights, influencing key business decisions and maximizing returns on commercial investments.

Partner closely with Marketing teams to provide financial insights and decision support for brands, innovations and commercial initiatives. 
Deliver ongoing financial analysis, modelling and business performance insights. 
Support Strategic Planning, AOP and forecasting processes. 
Analyze performance against plan, previous year and business targets, identifying risks and opportunities. 
Drive performance visibility across brand P&Ls and support commercial decision-making. 
Evaluate Advertising & Promotion (A&P) effectiveness and recommend optimization opportunities. 
Support productivity initiatives and value creation opportunities across brands. 
Manage controls related to pricing and A&P investments. 
Own performance dashboards, reporting routines and business performance visibility. 
Build business cases and financial models to support investments and strategic decisions. 
Support long-term strategic initiatives and special projects. 


Experience / Skills Required


3-5 years of experience in Finance, Commercial Finance, FP&A, Business Performance or related disciplines. 
Experience partnering with commercial, marketing or business teams. 
Strong financial modelling, analytical and business insight capabilities. 
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (mandatory). 
Experience building business cases, forecasts and performance reporting. 
Strong presentation, communication and stakeholder management skills. 
Experience with Power BI and SAP is highly desirable. 
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Finance or a related field. 
Experience within FMCG or Consumer Goods environments is highly valued. 
Advanced English proficiency is highly desirable. 
Proactive mindset, learning agility, and strong planning and organizational skills. 


Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you're supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

We recognize and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package.

Our purpose is to celebrate life, every day, everywhere. And creating an inclusive culture, where everyone feels valued and that they can belong, is a crucial part of this.

We embrace diversity in the broadest possible sense. This means that you'll be welcomed and celebrated for who you are just by being you.

Our ambition is to create the best performing, most trusted and respected consumer products companies in the world. Join us and help transform our business as we take our brands to new heights.

Feel inspired? Then this may be the opportunity for you.

description:
About the job

Business Development Representative — Financial Institutions

Location: United States — Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: Competitive base salary plus performance-based commissions

Company: QUASH.ai

About QUASH.ai

QUASH.ai is an AI-powered credit intelligence company helping financial institutions improve credit underwriting, fraud detection, and financial inclusion.

Our solutions combine alternative data, predictive scoring, decision engines, and artificial intelligence to help banks, credit unions, fintechs, and lenders make faster and more accurate decisions—particularly for consumers and small businesses with limited traditional credit history.

We are looking for a highly driven Business Development Representative who can identify financial institutions, engage the right decision-makers, conduct effective discovery calls, and consistently generate qualified sales opportunities for our commercial team.

The Role

The primary objective of this position is to generate at least 15 qualified sales opportunities per month following completed discovery calls.

This is not simply an appointment-setting role. The Business Development Representative will be expected to research accounts, identify relevant stakeholders, lead initial discovery conversations, understand the institution’s challenges, and determine whether there is a genuine opportunity for QUASH.ai.

The ideal candidate understands how financial institutions evaluate and purchase credit underwriting technology and is comfortable discussing solutions such as:

Credit risk scores
Alternative data
Credit decision engines
Automated underwriting
Financial inclusion
Fraud detection
Predictive analytics
Lending technology
AI-powered credit intelligence

The candidate will use sales automation, marketing automation, CRM, and generative AI tools to build scalable prospecting workflows across calls, email, SMS, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.

Key Performance Objective

The main performance target for this role is:

Generate a minimum of 15 qualified sales opportunities per month after completing discovery calls.

A qualified opportunity should:

Be with a bank, credit union, fintech, lender, or relevant financial-services organization.
Include an appropriate decision-maker, influencer, or internal champion.
Have a clearly identified business challenge or use case.
Demonstrate potential interest in QUASH.ai’s credit underwriting, fraud, alternative-data, or decisioning solutions.
Have an agreed next step with the QUASH.ai sales team.
Be properly documented and accepted as qualified within HubSpot.

The position includes:

A competitive base salary.
Variable compensation for achieving the monthly qualified-opportunity target.
Additional commission when an opportunity generated by the representative becomes a closed customer.

Because enterprise financial-services sales cycles may take several months, closed-business commissions will remain attributable to the representative even when the contract closes after the initial meeting, typically around three months later or according to the company’s commission plan.

Responsibilities
Research banks, credit unions, fintechs, lenders, and other target financial institutions.
Build and manage targeted account and prospect lists.
Identify credit, risk, underwriting, lending, fraud, innovation, data, and technology decision-makers.
Conduct outbound outreach through calls, emails, SMS, LinkedIn, and other approved channels.
Respond to and qualify inbound leads.
Lead initial discovery calls with prospective customers.
Understand each prospect’s current underwriting process, data sources, challenges, priorities, and technology environment.
Clearly present QUASH.ai’s value proposition and relevant use cases.
Determine whether a prospect meets the criteria for a qualified sales opportunity.
Schedule and coordinate follow-up meetings with account executives, product specialists, or company leadership.
Build multichannel prospecting and follow-up sequences using sales automation tools.
Use generative AI tools such as Claude to automate research, messaging, personalization, follow-up, and workflow creation.
Develop scalable outreach processes combining email, SMS, calls, LinkedIn, and automated follow-ups.
Maintain accurate account, contact, activity, and opportunity information within HubSpot.
Manage pipeline stages, tasks, notes, follow-ups, and reporting within the CRM.
Track performance against activity, discovery-call, qualified-opportunity, and revenue targets.
Collaborate with sales and marketing to improve targeting, messaging, campaigns, and conversion rates.
Provide feedback regarding lead quality, customer objections, competitive solutions, and market trends.
Represent QUASH.ai professionally in all customer and industry interactions.
Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate combines financial-services sales experience, strong discovery skills, commercial judgment, and the ability to use technology to generate pipeline efficiently.

The candidate should:

Have experience selling technology, software, data, or analytical solutions to financial institutions.
Understand the structure and decision-making process of banks, credit unions, fintechs, or lenders.
Be comfortable speaking with executives and senior professionals in credit, risk, lending, underwriting, fraud, innovation, technology, and data.
Be capable of independently leading an effective discovery call.
Know how to identify business problems, ask relevant questions, and qualify opportunities.
Have strong written and verbal communication skills.
Be persistent, organized, accountable, and highly focused on measurable results.
Be comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
Be able to manage a high volume of prospecting and follow-up activities.
Understand that success is measured by qualified pipeline creation, not only outreach activity or meetings scheduled.
Be comfortable using data and technology to continuously improve prospecting performance.
Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:

Selling to banks, credit unions, fintechs, or consumer lenders.
Selling credit underwriting or lending technology.
Credit risk scores or scoring models.
Alternative data solutions.
Automated decision engines.
Loan origination or decisioning platforms.
Credit bureau, identity, fraud, or data-enrichment products.
Predictive analytics or machine-learning solutions.
Financial inclusion or thin-file credit products.
SaaS or enterprise technology sales.
Business development within financial services.
Conducting discovery calls with senior financial-services professionals.
Building relationships with credit, risk, lending, fraud, or technology executives.

Experience in these areas is highly valuable but not required if the candidate can demonstrate a strong ability to learn the market and consistently generate qualified opportunities.

Technology and Automation Skills

The successful candidate should be comfortable using technology to create repeatable and scalable business-development workflows.

Relevant experience may include:

HubSpot CRM.
Sales engagement platforms.
Marketing automation tools.
Email sequencing tools.
Automated dialing or calling platforms.
SMS outreach tools.
LinkedIn prospecting tools.
Lead-enrichment and contact-data platforms.
Workflow automation tools.
Generative AI platforms such as Claude.
AI-assisted research, personalization, messaging, and follow-up.
CRM reporting, dashboards, and pipeline management.

The candidate should be able to use these tools to:

Research and prioritize accounts.
Identify the correct decision-makers.
Personalize messages at scale.
Automate multichannel outreach.
Create call, email, and SMS sequences.
Generate relevant follow-up content.
Maintain accurate CRM records.
Track performance and optimize conversion rates.

We are not looking only for someone who can manually call through a list. We are looking for someone capable of building a scalable, intelligent, and technology-enabled pipeline-generation system.

Qualifications
Demonstrated experience in business development, inside sales, enterprise sales, or sales development.
Experience conducting discovery calls and qualifying B2B opportunities.
Strong communication, active-listening, and presentation skills.
Ability to understand and explain technical or analytical products.
Experience using CRM and sales automation tools.
Strong organizational and pipeline-management skills.
Ability to work independently and collaborate across sales, marketing, product, and leadership teams.
Goal-oriented mindset with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding performance targets.
Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, finance, communications, technology, or a related field is preferred but not required.
Compensation

This is a fully paid position that includes:

Competitive base salary.
Monthly or quarterly variable compensation tied to qualified-opportunity generation.
Performance compensation for achieving or exceeding the target of 15 qualified opportunities per month.
Additional commission for opportunities that convert into closed business.
Potential for increased responsibilities and compensation based on performance.

The final compensation package will depend on the candidate’s experience, network, financial-services knowledge, and demonstrated ability to generate qualified pipeline.

Why Join QUASH.ai

This role offers the opportunity to join a growing AI and fintech company developing a new generation of credit intelligence products.

The successful candidate will work directly with senior leadership and have the opportunity to:

Sell innovative AI-powered solutions to financial institutions.
Help define and improve QUASH.ai’s U.S. go-to-market strategy.
Build scalable outbound and marketing-automation workflows.
Develop relationships with leaders across credit, risk, fraud, lending, and financial technology.
Earn meaningful performance-based compensation.
Grow into a senior business-development, account executive, or commercial leadership position.

description:
About the job

Operations Coordinator JD (Suprema LATAM)




Position Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Operations Coordinator to support our LATAM business by managing international order fulfillment, logistics coordination, and supply chain operations. The ideal candidate will ensure smooth execution of shipments, maintain close communication with internal teams and logistics partners, and deliver excellent operational support to customers across the region.




Key Responsibilities




International Operations & Logistics

Manage the end-to-end processing of Purchase Orders (PO), Sales Orders (SO), Commercial Invoices (CI), and Packing Lists (PL).
Monitor production schedules and shipment timelines to ensure on-time delivery.
Coordinate domestic and international shipments with DHL, FedEx, freight forwarders, and other logistics partners.
Request and verify shipment information, including weight, dimensions, and estimated shipping dates.
Coordinate shipment consolidations and international shipment rerouting when required.
Track Air Waybills (AWB) and courier tracking numbers, providing shipment status updates.
Resolve logistics issues and coordinate with carriers to ensure timely delivery.
Monitor customs clearance processes and support import/export operations.
Prepare and review export documentation to ensure compliance with international shipping requirements.
Manage Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) processes and coordinate warranty shipments.




Supply Chain & Procurement

Track purchase orders with suppliers to ensure timely delivery.
Coordinate material requests and procurement activities.
Communicate with suppliers regarding order status and delivery schedules.
Support inventory replenishment and supply planning to maintain operational continuity.




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, International Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in operations, logistics, supply chain, or international trade.
Experience handling international shipments and export documentation.
Familiarity with courier services (DHL, FedEx) and freight forwarding operations.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Excellent communication and coordination skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.
Spanish proficiency required; English is highly preferred.




Preferred Qualifications

Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, Zoho, Salesforce etc.).
Knowledge of import/export procedures and customs processes.
Experience working in a multinational environment.

 

5 key Questions

 

1. International Operations Experience

Can you describe your experience managing international orders and shipments from purchase order to final delivery? Which countries and logistics providers have you worked with?

 

2. Problem Solving

Tell us about a time when an international shipment was delayed or had a customs issue. What happened, and how did you resolve it?

 

3. Multitasking & Communication

This role requires managing multiple orders, suppliers, and internal teams simultaneously. How do you organize your work and prioritize urgent requests?

 

4. What ERP or order management systems have you used? (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, Odoo, Zoho, Salesforce, etc.)

 

5.What is your English level? Have you communicated directly with overseas suppliers or headquarters in English?

About the job

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, creating one of the world’s most comprehensive skills development platforms for the AI era. This strengthens our ability to accelerate AI-powered innovation and shape how the world discovers and builds skills at a pivotal moment of change. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

About Udemy

Udemy is an AI-powered skills acceleration platform transforming how companies and individuals across the world build the capabilities needed to thrive in a rapidly evolving workplace. By combining on-demand, multi-language content with real-time innovation, Udemy delivers personalized experiences that empower organizations to scale workforce development and help individuals build the technical, business, and soft skills most relevant to their careers. Today, thousands of companies, including Samsung SDS America, On24, Tata Consultancy Services, The World Bank, and Volkswagen, rely on Udemy Business for its enterprise solutions to build agile, future-ready teams. Udemy is headquartered in San Francisco, with hubs across the United States, Australia, India, Ireland, Mexico, and Türkiye. Udemy recently combined with Coursera to create one of the world’s most comprehensive skills development platforms.

About You

You’re a connector who puts people first and values the lasting partnerships you’ll build. You’re an active listener who cares about the stories people share and are energized by communication and collaboration. You love learning new things and are known for bringing innovative perspectives and questions to the table. You’re deadline and results-driven, passionate about creating new processes, systems, and best practices that help your internal partners do their best work.

About This Role

As a Senior Customer Experience Analyst, you will split your time between resolving complex or specialized customer escalations and driving individual or team projects across the following operational areas: vendor management, content/wiki management, operational readiness, operational excellence and process development, and data analysis and insights.

Because our frontline associates resolve the vast majority of customer requests, escalations by definition require critical thinking, thoughtfulness, and a gentle touch. That’s where you come in! Your work as the final level of support escalation will involve managing and prioritizing multiple requests at once, communicating with customers directly to gather information or share outcomes, offering assistance to our Tier 1 and Tier 2 support associates, and often coordinating on complex resolutions with cross-functional teams. On the project side, your end-to-end ownership will encompass planning and coordination through implementation, and the validation of impact or identification of additional follow-up work. You will become familiar with all aspects of our team’s operations, but we are particularly interested in candidates with a background and interest in content/wiki management or data analysis and insights.

This position offers an opportunity for professional growth through managing impactful projects and mentoring junior team members, and your contributions to larger organization-wide will give you exposure to a range of cross-functional teams including Customer Success, Internal Escalations, Product/Engineering, Tax, Revenue Operations, Legal, and more.

What You’ll Be Doing

Customer escalations


Resolving sensitive and complex escalations with empathy, thoughtfulness, tact, sound judgment, clear communication, and minimal oversight. 
Identifying and escalating significant customer experience changes that affect our customers or business operations (e.g. outages or software failures, changes in sentiment, issue trends). 
Collaborating cross-functionally via Slack, Zoom, and in-person to gather information, summarize findings, and resolve issues. 
Providing guidance and coaching to our frontline support associates when they request assistance. 
Developing subject matter expertise on Udemy Business’s products, customers, support processes, and internal cross-functional partnerships. 


Operational work


Proposing and driving operational improvement projects from planning through implementation, monitoring, and reporting outcomes. 
Proactively communicating project updates, blockers, or improvement opportunities to stakeholders, and leverage available resources – including data, tooling, documentation, and peer/cross-functional stakeholders – to develop insights and drive outcomes. 
Contributing to broader organizational and cross-functional initiatives. 


What you’ll have: 


Proven experience resolving complex customer issues with minimal oversight, preferably as part of a global team within a hybrid workplace model. 
A track record of identifying and seizing opportunities to uplevel the customer experience via process improvements and cross-functional recommendations. 
The desire to balance self-sufficiency, ownership, and accountability with teamwork and collaboration. 
Nice to have – Experience working with any of the following systems or tools: Service Cloud, Zendesk, Atlassian (Jira and Confluence), Asana, Tableau, UnitQ, Salesforce, and Stripe 


About Your Skills


Complex Issue Resolution: You are skilled at managing sensitive, intricate escalations independently, using empathy, judgment, and tact to find solutions. You excel in identifying and addressing broader customer experience issues, working collaboratively with cross-functional teams to resolve complex cases effectively. 
Project and Process Management: You lead projects end-to-end, from planning through implementation, continuously improving processes and enhancing team efficiency. You prioritize effectively, balancing multiple projects and initiatives with a focus on quality, efficiency, and impactful outcomes. And you are comfortable working with autonomy and ambiguity. 
Data-Driven Decision Making: You leverage tools, data, insights, and cross-functional relationships to make informed decisions and meaningful recommendations. Resourceful and analytical, you use available resources to track outcomes and identify opportunities for improvement, particularly in areas like content management, prompt engineering, and operational insights. 
Adaptable and Strategic Communication: You communicate clearly and effectively across all levels, from customer interactions to executive updates, and can adapt your style to various audiences. Strong in relationship-building, you respectfully challenge ideas, reach compromises, and support team members through mentorship and guidance. 


We understand that not everyone will match each of the above qualifications. However, we also realize that everyone has unique experiences that can add value to our company. Even if you think your background might not perfectly align, we'd love to hear from you!

At Udemy, we strive to be transparent around compensation. Actual compensation for this role is based on several factors, including but not limited to job-related skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition to a base salary, this role is also eligible for equity.

Hiring Compensation Range

$440,000—$550,000 MXN

Why work here?

You’ll grow here.

Learning is part of the job. You’ll get full access to Udemy courses, a monthly UDay to invest in yourself, and a budget to spend on whatever helps you improve. Many people are diving into AI lately, but what you focus on is up to you.

AI is real here.

We use it in the way we learn and the way we work. You’ll have the space and tools to experiment, apply, and get better at using AI in practical ways.

You’ll own your work.

We trust people to lead, make decisions, and follow through. You don’t need to wait for permission or layers of approval to have an impact.

You’ll Build With Others.

We collaborate openly and shape ideas together. Everyone has a voice, and good thinking is welcomed from any direction.

You’ll see your impact.

What you build helps people grow their skills, change their careers, or find a path forward. You’ve got the experience, why not use it to help others gain theirs?

Bring your curiosity. We’ll bring the platform and the support. Let’s LEARN together. 

Our Benefits Start With U

Our benefits start with you and were built to provide you and your family with the protection and care you need, making it easy to access the right coverage when you need it most. Benefits vary by region, and we encourage applicants to review our Australia Benefits, India Benefits, Ireland Benefits, Mexico Benefits, Turkiye Benefits & US Benefits, pages to get an understanding of some of the benefits we offer. For details on region-specific benefits, please refer to the information provided during the hiring process.

Benefits outlined are provided as a general overview and may vary depending on the location, role, and employment classification. All benefits are subject to change at the discretion of the organization and in accordance with applicable laws and policies.

At Udemy, we value diversity and inclusion and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, medical condition, or disability. We understand that not everyone will match each of the qualifications. However, we also realize that everyone has unique experiences that can add value to our company. Even if you think your background might not perfectly align, we'd love to hear from you! 

To protect against recruitment fraud, Coursera + Udemy recruiters only communicate via official coursera.org/udemy.com email addresses and never through personal accounts. We do not accept resumes via email or social media; please submit all applications directly through our careers page. If you encounter suspicious recruitment activity, please report it via our Fraudulent Activity Submission Form.

Information regarding data privacy is available within the Udemy Careers Privacy Notice.

Own your discovery calls end to end from booking through close. You qualify, you present the value of MDS authentically, you handle objections, and you guide the right founders through the application.

Follow up persistently and personally with prospects who are interested but not yet ready. You don’t let warm leads go cold because of poor follow-through.
Represent MDS at industry events and tradeshows (Amazon Accelerate, Prosper Show, SellerCon, ShipBob Summit, and similar) as a relationship-builder and pipeline generator.
Convert in-person conversations to pipeline entries with same-day GHL logging and a follow-up action in place for every qualified contact before you leave the event floor.

Flag events worth attending that aren’t yet on the team’s radar based on what you’re seeing in the market. You are a source of field intelligence, not just a field executor.

Execute multi-channel follow-up sequences (email, SMS, personal outreach) that keep qualified founders engaged without being pushy or generic.

3+ years in sales, business development, or a community-facing role with a demonstrable track record of hitting individual targets. Not a team average, your own number.

An existing network within the Amazon, Shopify, or TikTok Shop seller community, people who know you and would take your call. This is a meaningful accelerator in this role.
Personal experience as an ecommerce seller or brand operator. Lived experience is the fastest shortcut to credibility with our ideal member.

Experience with membership communities, masterminds, or high-ticket group offers so you understand the value proposition intuitively and can articulate it without a script.
Experience with multi-channel outreach sequences including email, SMS, and social DMs in a coordinated, personalized way.

Annual bonus pool participation, contingent on year-over-year growth in Membership Income (MI) and maintaining a 75% average in defined KPIs. Bonus accrues yearly: 50% paid at year-end, remainder paid mid-year following.
Team member referral bonus: $750 to $2,500 for successful hires referred, contingent on both parties remaining employed at least six months.
Spot bonuses awarded at the executive team’s discretion for exceptional performance, a landmark close, or a high-impact event result.

Exclusive Event Access: Represent MDS at exclusive, high-profile events as the primary face of our community. These are gateways to new relationships, cultures, and a global professional network.

description:
About the job

SOBRE EFEX




EFEX es una institución financiera regulada que opera el corredor de pagos entre México, Estados Unidos y el resto del mundo. Nuestros clientes son empresas que le pagan a proveedores en el extranjero, cobran a clientes fuera de México, administran tesorería en varias divisas o recibieron inversión extranjera.




Operamos cuatro líneas de negocio: transferencias internacionales, transferencias masivas, cobranza internacional en moneda local y cuentas empresariales multi-divisa. Enviamos pagos a más de 140 países, cobramos localmente en más de 24 y operamos en once divisas.




Estamos autorizados por la CNBV como transmisor de dinero y cumplimos con la regulación de FinCEN en Estados Unidos. Nos respaldan PayPal Ventures, Franklin Templeton, Floodgate, 500 Startups y Nido Ventures. Tenemos oficinas en Ciudad de México, Monterrey, Guadalajara, Querétaro, Tijuana y Palo Alto.




Lo que vendemos es simple de explicar: el nivel de sofisticación financiera de un corporativo grande, sin la complejidad de operar con varios bancos.




SOBRE EL PUESTO




Vas a ser el primer contacto de EFEX con empresas mexicanas de comercio exterior. Tu trabajo es encontrar a las que están perdiendo dinero en cada pago al extranjero, entender cómo operan hoy y llevarlas a una conversación con un especialista.




No cierras contratos en este puesto. Abres conversaciones con áreas de finanzas (que es la parte más difícil del ciclo comercial) y trabajas junto a un especialista que se encarga del cierre.




RESPONSABILIDADES




Contactar por teléfono a alrededor de 50 empresas al día. Los leads los provee el equipo de Growth: no inviertes tu tiempo construyendo listas.
Conversar con dueños de negocio, direcciones de finanzas, contraloría y tesorería para entender cómo pagan y cobran al extranjero hoy, y qué les cuesta.
Calificar la cuenta: identificar volumen real de pagos internacionales, divisas involucradas y fricción con su banco actual.
Usar herramientas de IA para investigar la cuenta antes de llamar, preparar el abordaje y dar seguimiento. Es parte del método de trabajo del equipo.
Agendar la junta y hacer el traspaso al especialista con el contexto completo.
Mantener el registro en el CRM al día.




PUEDE QUE ENCAJES SI




Tienes licenciatura, titulada o pasante, en finanzas, contaduría, derecho, relaciones internacionales, comercio internacional, economía, administración o carrera afín.
Has trabajado antes en empresas formales.
Tienes experiencia en ventas, o un gusto genuino por vender. Cualquiera de las dos funciona.
Te interesan los temas bancarios y de divisas. No necesitas dominarlos, pero sí tener curiosidad real por cómo una empresa mueve su dinero: tipo de cambio, tesorería, banca empresarial, comercio exterior.
Te sientes a gusto trabajando con IA. Si ya usas Claude, ChatGPT o Gemini, mejor. Si no, con disposición a aprenderlas es suficiente: aquí se usan a diario.
Estás cómodo con el teléfono y con el volumen. Este puesto es de llamadas todos los días.
Lees inglés a nivel intermedio o avanzado.
Trabajas con orden: registras, das seguimiento y no dejas cabos sueltos.
El "no" no te desarma. Vas a escuchar varios antes de cada "sí".




No pedimos experiencia previa en fintech ni en banca. Eso se aprende aquí.




SUMAN PUNTOS




Experiencia previa como SDR, en telemarketing, call center o cobranza.

Conocimiento de comercio exterior, aduanas, logística o banca empresarial.

Haber trabajado con HubSpot o cualquier otro CRM.




COMPENSACIÓN




Sueldo base de USD competitivo, según experiencia. El pago es en dólares.
Adicionalmente, comisión por cada cliente que llega a realizar su primera transferencia fondeada. La comisión escala con el tamaño de la cuenta y no tiene tope superior. No existe cuota mínima que alcanzar antes de cobrarla: se paga desde el primer cliente.




LOGÍSTICA




Ubicación: Ciudad de México, esquema híbrido.

Pago en dólares.

Jornada completa.




CÓMO APLICAR




Envía tu CV por mensaje directo en LinkedIn o aplica en la vacante. Las dos rutas llegan al mismo lugar.




Si quieres agregar contexto a tu postulación, cuéntanos en un párrafo cuál es la conversación más difícil que has tenido que iniciar con un desconocido y cómo la abriste. Es opcional, y lo leemos.




Te recomendamos aplicar aunque sientas que no cumples con todos los puntos de la lista. Preferimos conocerte y evaluarlo juntos.

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

description:
About the job

#ZCC 

Zurich Capability Center is looking for:

Business Operations Analyst

Zurich is expanding support for the Contingent Workforce & Supplier Governance team and is seeking a Business Operations Analyst who will support the program for North America while interfacing enterprise wide. This role will provide operational, reporting, documentation, and system support for the Beeline vendor management system (VMS), working closely with the North America FlexForce team, business stakeholders, suppliers, and cross-functional partners. The role will support process consistency, service quality, and continuous improvement across contingent workforce and supplier governance activities.

Responsibilities:


Support Beeline VMS operations for the North America FlexForce team, including Jira-based ticket intake, issue tracking, defect documentation, enhancement requests, testing support, and follow-up through resolution.
Create, validate, and maintain recurring and ad hoc reports from Beeline and related data sources to support workforce governance, compliance monitoring, supplier oversight, and leadership reporting.
Analyze and organize contingent workforce data to identify trends, exceptions, data quality issues, and opportunities for process improvement.
Support engagement managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders by researching and resolving VMS, reporting, and process-related inquiries in partnership with the FlexForce team.
Document standard operating procedures, job aids, process flows, decision logs, and training materials to improve consistency and knowledge transfer across the support model.
Assist with requirements gathering, test case development, user acceptance testing, and implementation support for Beeline enhancements, reporting updates, and process changes.
Provide project coordination, task tracking, status updates, and issue escalation support for assigned FlexForce initiatives and operational deliverables.
Partner with North America stakeholders to ensure timely communication, accurate documentation, and alignment with established governance and compliance expectations.
Contribute to operational efficiency and automation initiatives by leveraging APIs, Power Automate, and Power BI to support process improvements, stakeholder dashboards, supplier reporting, and day-to-day operational activities.
Support change management activities, including communications, training coordination, adoption tracking, and transition support for new or updated contingent workforce processes.


Basic Qualifications:


Bachelor’s Degree and 3 or more years of experience in Business Analysis, Operations, Shared Services, Vendor Management, Workforce Operations, or related area


OR


High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in Business Analysis, Operations, Shared Services, Vendor Management, Workforce Operations, or related area


OR


3 or more years of experience in Business Analysis, Operations, Shared Services, Vendor Management, Workforce Operations, or related area


AND


Experience supporting operational processes, reporting, project coordination, or system-related business support


Preferred:


Experience with a Vendor Management System, contingent workforce process, procurement operations, or shared services support model
Experience using Jira for ticket management, including intake, prioritization, tracking, status updates, and resolution follow-up
Change management and process management
Strong verbal and written skills with the ability to clearly articulate requirements
Data analysis, analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills
Experience using Power BI to develop, maintain, and interpret dashboards and reports that support operational insights and leadership decision-making
Strong organizational and time management skills
Experience identifying process improvement, automation, or AI-enabled solutions to improve operational efficiency
Experience leveraging APIs, Power Automate, Power BI, or similar tools to automate workflows, streamline reporting, and improve operational processes
Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and communicate clearly across teams and time zones


Who We Are

Looking for a challenging and inspiring work environment where you can make a difference? At Zurich millions of individuals and businesses place their trust in our products and services every day. Our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, enabling, businesses and communities to face a world of risk with confidence. Imagine if you could help people do this all over the world. You’d give them confidence and reassurance by protecting what they love most. It’s a big challenge, but you will be supported by a world-class team who believe in helping you to reach your full potential and deliver on our promises. So be challenged. Be inspired. Help us make a difference. At Zurich we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best qualified individuals available, without regard to race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

Etapa inicial: Período de evaluación de 60 días con compensación 100% variable

Oportunidad de contratación: Al generar al menos 10 reuniones calificadas en un mes, la persona pasará automáticamente a una posición de tiempo completo con salario base.

Acerca de QUASH.ai

QUASH.ai es una empresa de tecnología financiera e inteligencia artificial que ayuda a instituciones financieras a tomar decisiones de crédito más rápidas, inclusivas y precisas.

Nuestra tecnología combina datos alternativos, analítica predictiva y automatización con inteligencia artificial para ayudar a los prestamistas a identificar oportunidades que los modelos tradicionales de crédito pueden dejar fuera.

Buscamos a una persona recursiva, con madera comercial y mentalidad orientada a resultados, que sepa encontrar prospectos, iniciar conversaciones y generar oportunidades comerciales calificadas.

Esta no es una posición tradicional con salario fijo desde el primer día. Es una oportunidad basada en desempeño, diseñada para alguien que quiera demostrar sus capacidades y obtener una posición de tiempo completo a través de resultados medibles.

Programa de Evaluación de 60 Días

El período inicial estará dividido en dos etapas:

Primer mes — Aprendizaje y construcción

Durante el primer mes, la persona aprenderá sobre:

Las soluciones y productos de QUASH.ai.
Nuestros perfiles de cliente ideal.
El mercado de instituciones financieras, fintech y prestamistas.
Nuestros mensajes comerciales y procesos de ventas.
Las herramientas de enriquecimiento de leads de QUASH.ai.
Las tecnologías de automatización y prospección disponibles.

También deberá comenzar a construir, probar y mejorar sus propios flujos de prospección y generación de oportunidades.

Segundo mes — Ejecución y generación de reuniones

Durante el segundo mes, la persona deberá ejecutar activamente su estrategia comercial, incluyendo:

Identificación de cuentas objetivo.
Contacto con tomadores de decisiones.
Calificación inicial de prospectos.
Realización de conversaciones comerciales.
Presentación de QUASH.ai.
Coordinación de reuniones calificadas para el equipo de ventas.

Durante estos 60 días, la compensación será completamente variable y estará basada en resultados, bajo condiciones acordadas antes de comenzar.

La persona que genere al menos 10 reuniones calificadas durante un mismo mes pasará automáticamente a una posición de tiempo completo con salario base y un paquete de compensación que será definido con su jefe directo.

Para ser consideradas calificadas, las reuniones deberán:

Incluir a un tomador de decisiones o persona relevante dentro de la organización.
Corresponder a una empresa que encaje con el perfil de cliente ideal de QUASH.ai.
Tener un interés o necesidad potencial relacionada con las soluciones de QUASH.ai.
Ser efectivamente realizadas, no solamente agendadas.
Responsabilidades
Investigar instituciones financieras, fintechs, prestamistas y otras cuentas objetivo.
Identificar a los tomadores de decisiones correctos dentro de cada organización.
Determinar los mejores canales y estrategias para contactar a cada prospecto.
Realizar prospección a través de correo electrónico, llamadas, SMS, LinkedIn y otros canales relevantes.
Calificar leads inbound y outbound.
Comprender las necesidades, desafíos y prioridades de cada prospecto.
Presentar claramente la propuesta de valor de QUASH.ai.
Liderar o participar en llamadas iniciales de descubrimiento.
Coordinar reuniones calificadas para el equipo comercial.
Construir flujos automatizados de prospección y marketing utilizando Claude, herramientas de inteligencia artificial, plataformas de enriquecimiento de leads y tecnologías internas de QUASH.ai.
Crear secuencias multicanal que combinen correos electrónicos, llamadas, SMS, LinkedIn y otros medios.
Mantener actualizados los registros, actividades y oportunidades dentro del CRM.
Dar seguimiento constante a prospectos y oportunidades en etapas iniciales.
Trabajar junto con los equipos de ventas y marketing para mejorar los mensajes, la segmentación y las tasas de conversión.
Compartir información sobre la calidad de los leads, objeciones frecuentes, competidores y tendencias del mercado.
Medir su rendimiento con base en objetivos semanales y mensuales.
Perfil que buscamos

La principal calificación para esta posición no es un título universitario ni un cargo anterior específico.

Buscamos a alguien con instinto comercial, capacidad de aprendizaje, creatividad y autonomía para generar oportunidades.

La persona ideal:

Tiene madera comercial y facilidad para vender, comunicar y construir relaciones.
Se siente cómoda hablando con ejecutivos y profesionales del sector financiero.
Puede realizar una llamada de descubrimiento de manera clara y profesional.
Sabe investigar empresas e identificar a los tomadores de decisiones correctos.
Tiene contactos relevantes o sabe cómo desarrollar relaciones y llegar a las personas adecuadas.
Es persistente, organizada, creativa y disciplinada con el seguimiento.
Puede trabajar de manera independiente en un entorno remoto.
Se siente cómoda siendo evaluada con base en resultados medibles.
Aprende rápidamente nuevas tecnologías.
Utiliza inteligencia artificial para trabajar de forma más rápida y eficiente.
Es capaz de diseñar y automatizar sus propios procesos de prospección.
No depende exclusivamente de listas de prospectos proporcionadas por la empresa.
Puede construir sus propios flujos de marketing y ventas utilizando diferentes canales.
Experiencia ideal — No obligatoria

Será valorada positivamente la experiencia en alguna de las siguientes áreas:

Call centers.
Atención al cliente.
Televentas.
Generación de citas.
Ventas internas.
Venta de software o soluciones SaaS.
Fintech o servicios financieros.
Venta de productos tecnológicos.
Bancos, cooperativas de crédito, prestamistas o instituciones financieras.
Sistemas de CRM y plataformas de automatización comercial.
LinkedIn y herramientas de prospección.
Automatización de correos electrónicos y secuencias de contacto.
Plataformas de enriquecimiento de leads.
Uso de Claude u otras herramientas de inteligencia artificial.
Diseño de flujos automatizados de marketing y ventas.
Prospección, calificación de leads o realización de llamadas de descubrimiento.

Tener un título universitario en negocios, marketing, comunicaciones o un área relacionada será considerado favorablemente, pero no es obligatorio.

La habilidad más importante

Uno de los aspectos más importantes para esta posición será la capacidad de utilizar Claude, inteligencia artificial y las tecnologías de enriquecimiento de leads disponibles en QUASH.ai para crear procesos automatizados de generación de oportunidades.

Esperamos que la persona pueda diseñar sus propios flujos comerciales combinando canales como:

Correo electrónico.
Llamadas.
SMS.
LinkedIn.
Mensajes automatizados.
Investigación de cuentas.
Enriquecimiento de contactos.
Seguimientos automáticos.
Calificación inicial de prospectos.

No buscamos únicamente a una persona que realice llamadas manualmente. Buscamos a alguien capaz de construir un sistema de prospección escalable, automatizado y orientado a resultados.

¿Para quién es esta oportunidad?

Esta posición es ideal para alguien que considera que su desempeño puede hablar más fuerte que su currículum.

Puede ser una persona con experiencia comercial, alguien que haya trabajado en atención al cliente o call centers y quiera entrar al mundo de las ventas tecnológicas, o una persona con conocimientos de inteligencia artificial capaz de construir procesos creativos para generar leads.

En QUASH.ai tendrá la oportunidad de aprender sobre el producto, desarrollar su estrategia, ejecutarla y obtener una posición de tiempo completo a través de sus resultados.

Cómo aplicar

Para aplicar, envía tu currículum o perfil de LinkedIn junto con una breve explicación de:

Cómo identificarías clientes potenciales para QUASH.ai.
Qué canales utilizarías para contactar a tomadores de decisiones en instituciones financieras.
Cómo utilizarías inteligencia artificial y automatización para generar 10 reuniones calificadas en un mes.

title: Multimedia Designer/AI Artist
description:
About the job

Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

About The Role

Monks is seeking a visionary AI Specialist to join our specialized team. We manage a complex product account requiring expertise far beyond typical social media marketing. This is a hybrid role demanding both technical proficiency and creative strategy.

You will be the bridge between cutting-edge AI developments and engaging social content. Your focus will be on anticipating the future of LLM’s by exploring the current AI landscape, utilizing APIs and coding knowledge to experiment and prototype. Your work will not only keep our social channels ahead of the curve but will also educate our internal teams and our external audience of AI enthusiasts.

Responsibilities

Technical Foresight & Landscape Analysis. Actively monitor developments from Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic to anticipate upcoming AI features. Maintain deep knowledge of the broader AI landscape to provide strategic insights.

Advanced Content Creation & Prototyping. Create compelling social content for X and Instagram targeted at AI enthusiasts. Design and execute complex prompts and utilize API’s to prototype internal tools, test new capabilities, and produce unique images, videos, and copy.

Internal Training & Enablement. Serve as the go-to AI expert, bridging the knowledge gap within the organization. Develop and lead training sessions for creative, strategy, and design teams on new and upcoming AI features.

Playbook Development & Documentation. Document internal use cases and build comprehensive playbooks on how to integrate AI tools (including the Google Work Suite) effectively across the company's strategy, creative, and operations departments.

Education & Demystification. Be a key part of our strategy to demystify AI. For external content, break down the prompts and the technical details (including API usage when relevant) in an engaging, easy-to-understand way.

Client-Facing Engagement. You may also be called upon to engage directly with clients, leveraging your AI expertise to collaboratively problem-solve and educate them on efficient prompting techniques, ensuring they can maximize the utility of AI tools.

About You

Technical Proficiency (Required): Proven experience in coding and hands-on proficiency in working with AI/ML APIs. You must be comfortable exploring technical documentation and building or testing tools.

A Master of Prompts & AI Ecosystems: A proven ability to get extraordinary results from generative AI tools. You must be "in the weeds" with current LLM’s.

A Natural Trainer and Explainer: Excellent at translating complex, technical concepts into simple, engaging language. You must have a passion for training others and documenting processes.

Social Savvy (Niche Expertise): Deep understanding of what resonates with the AI enthusiast community on platforms like X, and the ability to advise copywriters on relevant technical trends.

A Creative Problem-Solver: You love a challenge and enjoy figuring out how to use new technology, including APIs, to solve creative problems, build internal tools, and optimize workflows.

At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants, from all backgrounds, who are excited to contribute to our mission.

 TS1

About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4 Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global Marketing and Technology Services to redefine how brands interact with the world. Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long-term impact.

Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services, ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization, Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2025 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in both the Organizational and AI Product categories. As a trusted partner to cutting-edge innovators in tech, Monks earned titles such as Optimizely Experimentation Partner of the Year (2025), runner-up for the Adobe Firefly Partner Award (2024), and Workato’s AI Visionary Customer Impact Award (2024). Additionally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

Strong Excel skills and experience creating operational reports and dashboards.
Experience coordinating with multiple stakeholders, including dealers, suppliers, warehouses, finance teams, and external partners.
Knowledge of dealership operations and aftersales processes.
Experience with DMS or aftersales systems is a plus.
Intermediate to advanced English communication skills.

Analytical Thinking
Attention to Detail
Problem Solving
Process Improvement
Operational Excellence

Customer Focus

description:
About the job

No Relocation Assistance Offered

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specialising in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

About The Role

Are you passionate about skincare, education, and empowering others to succeed? As our Training Specialist for Filorga, you will be the driving force behind the development and execution of dynamic teaching and learning experiences for our sales force, dermatologists, aesthetic doctors, and medical staff.

In this role, you will foster a culture of continuous learning, ensuring our teams and partners master Filorga’s innovative product portfolio, advanced skin knowledge, and effective sales techniques. By combining your passion for skincare with engaging training methodologies, you will directly contribute to brand prescription, awareness, and commercial success across Mexico!

Main Responsibilities


Needs Analysis & Strategy: Identify key training needs across targets to design, plan, and implement comprehensive training programs focused on Filorga products, skincare science, and effective sales techniques. 
Training Delivery: Facilitate engaging in-person and virtual training sessions for the sales force, skin specialists, and medical staff both in Mexico City and across the country. 
Content & Material Creation: Prepare and continuously update high-impact presentations, induction plans, videos, and digital materials for diverse channels (doctors, staff, and pharmacies), integrating new product launches seamlessly. 
Localization & Adaptability: Translate and adapt international training materials from brand headquarters to resonate perfectly with the local market. 
Evaluation & Reporting: Design performance assessments to measure product knowledge and maintain detailed training records to track progress for monthly and annual business reports. 
Logistics & Material Management: Oversee training assets (brochures, minis, testers, kits, banners) and maintain key brand awareness tools such as the vademecum and patient brochures. 
Digital Innovation: Leverage modern learning platforms and applications to enhance the delivery and reach of training programs. 


Basic Qualifications


Education: Completed Bachelor's degree. 
Experience: At least 2 years of proven professional experience in training, learning & development, or educational content delivery. 
Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in presentation tools (PowerPoint / Google Slides) and functional knowledge of Excel. 
Interpersonal & Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with strong active listening and empathy. 
Mobility: High availability to travel across the Mexican Republic and flexibility to adapt to dynamic training schedules. 


Preferred Qualifications


Industry Knowledge: Background or strong familiarity with skin anatomy, aesthetic medicine, skin pathologies, facials, or skincare application techniques. 
Dermo-Cosmetic or Retail Background: Prior experience working with dermatological skincare brands (e.g., Bioderma, Avène, Isdin, La Roche-Posay, SkinCeuticals, Medik8) or prestige retail beauty brands. 
Instructional Design: Experience in designing and developing structured learning courses and digital training content. 
Tech Savvy: Familiarity with digital learning platforms and interactive tools that elevate the virtual training experience.

description:
About the job

Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! Vonage Communications APIs:

As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more.

Why this role matters:

Our Customer Success Training Specialist will provide the foundational learning for our Customer Success teams. In this role you will be the architect of the CS journey, from the moment a new CSM joins to the mastery of our post-sales ecosystem.

Your key responsibilities:
End-to-End Onboarding: Design and lead a world-class onboarding program that gets new CSMs up to speed on our product, our customers, and our unique approach to partnership.
Continuous Enablement: Develop post-onboarding curricula that keep the team sharp on new feature releases, industry trends, and advanced account management strategies ; including expansion positioning from upselling and cross-selling 
Needs Assessment: Identify knowledge and skill gaps through data-driven assessments, aligning all training programs to revenue priorities and business objectives.
Blended Learning Delivery: Develop and deliver engaging learning experiences—including live workshops, virtual sessions, and eLearning—for global CS teams of all experience levels.
Tactical Content Creation: Build practical exercises, job aids, and visual guides that translate technical API capabilities and product updates into actionable "Success Plays."
Tools & Stack Mastery: Serve as the subject matter expert for the CS toolset (Gong, Salesforce andPlanhat,ensuring the team navigates our systems with speed and precision.
Strategic Partnership: Collaborate with CS Leadership to drive accountability and partner with Sales Enablement to ensure cohesive product and process updates across the revenue org.
Advocacy & Improvement: Serve as a trusted advisor and champion for continuous improvement in CS skills, processes, and training best practices.

 

What you’ll bring:

To be successful in this role, you should be a blend of an educator, a strategist, and a Customer Success advocate. We are looking for someone who understands that CS is both an art and a science. 

Required:

CS Enablement Background: 2–4 years of experience in Customer Success training and enablement. If you’ve previously carried a book of business as a CSM, that’s a major plus.
The "CS Lens" on Sales Process: A solid understanding of the B2B lifecycle. You understand how discovery, handoffs, and pipeline management directly impact long-term retention and expansion.
CS Tech Stack Power User: High proficiency in Salesforce and Planhat (or similar CS Platform such as Gainsight, Totango, Hubspot, Zendesk, and Churn Zero etc.). You are comfortable being the "go-to" expert who helps others navigate our tools with speed and precision.
Instructional Design Mastery: Experience creating clean, professional training materials, slide decks, and tutorials. Proficiency in Articulate (or similar authoring tools) is required to build our eLearning library.
Strong Facilitation Skills: You are a confident, engaging presenter who can break down complex API capabilities or process-heavy workflows into simple, actionable steps.

Experience we consider a plus:

Cross-Functional Collaborator: Ability to work effectively with Sales/CS Ops, Product Marketing, and CS Managers to ensure content is technically accurate and relevant to the field.
Detail-Oriented & Precise: A passion for accuracy and a "get it right" mindset when documenting internal processes and system workflows.
Strategic Advisor: A champion for continuous improvement who isn't afraid to identify skill gaps and propose creative solutions to fill them.
Methodology Knowledge: A background in MEDDPICC or similar sales/success methodologies is a significant advantage.
Where you will work:

This position offers a fully remote work arrangement based out of Mexico.

Sponsorship is not available. Legal authorization to work in Mexico is required. We are unable to sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. 

 

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice. 

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

About the job

About Hirably

At Hirably, we connect exceptional talent with the best opportunities. We're looking for a Customer Success Representative to join our fully remote team, delivering top-tier service experiences to clients in the automotive industry.




Position Details

Location: 100% remote.
Salary: $20,000 MXN net per month.
Christmas bonus (aguinaldo): 15 days.
Vacation: 12 days.




Role Overview

As a Customer Success Representative, you'll serve as the first point of contact for customers scheduling automotive service appointments. This role requires strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to meet daily performance expectations.




Core Responsibilities

Inbound Service Calls

Answer incoming service calls promptly and professionally.
Gather customer information using approved verification steps (name, callback number, email, VIN/vehicle, mileage).
Identify customer service needs, confirm required services, and schedule appointments according to guidelines.
Document all interactions accurately in the CRM.
Handle a minimum of 50 inbound calls per day.




Outbound Service Calls

Complete 400 outbound dials per day (full-time).
Maintain a minimum 15% appointment set conversion rate.
Make follow-up calls for declined work, maintenance reminders, missed appointments, and overdue service opportunities.
Update customer records and log outcomes accurately.




Customer Verification Expectations

Introduce yourself and brand on behalf of the client.
Confirm whether the customer is scheduling today.
Identify if the customer is new or returning.
Verify phone number, email address, and name.
Confirm vehicle information and mileage.
Review service requests or recommended maintenance.
Ask transportation preference (waiting, shuttle, loaner, etc.).
Offer the first available appointment date/time.
Confirm final appointment details.

Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.
Ability to follow structured scripts and call flows.
High level of organization and attention to detail.
Ability to multitask across several systems.
Strong typing and computer navigation skills.
Excellent customer service and professionalism.
Ability to handle high call volumes with consistency.




Technical Requirements

High-speed internet capable of supporting multiple scheduling systems and call software without interruption.

About the job

Job Title: Customer Success Operations Coordinator
Schedule: Part-Time (20 hours/week initially), with the potential to expand based on performance and business needs
Location: Remote (Latin America Preferred)




Overview

Enjoy building strong client relationships while keeping operations running smoothly behind the scenes?




Join a growing healthcare cybersecurity company dedicated to helping healthcare organizations strengthen their security posture, protect sensitive data, and navigate today's evolving cybersecurity landscape. As the company continues to expand, they are seeking a Customer Success Operations Coordinator to become the operational backbone of their client success function.




In this role, you'll serve as the primary communication bridge between clients and internal technical teams, ensuring seamless coordination, exceptional client experiences, and long-term relationship success. This opportunity is ideal for a highly organized, detail-oriented professional who enjoys managing multiple stakeholders, communicating with confidence, and keeping projects moving forward. While deep cybersecurity expertise isn't required, an understanding of IT terminology and the ability to communicate technical concepts in client-friendly language will set you up for success.




Key Responsibilities

Organize, schedule, and coordinate Quarterly Business Review (QBR) calls with clients
Ensure meeting participants are prepared and supporting materials are delivered in advance
Serve as the primary point of contact for existing clients, responding to inquiries and coordinating internal follow-up
Facilitate communication between clients and internal technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution
Coordinate crisis communications during security incidents through phone, email, and text
Engage with clients during quarterly reviews to understand their needs and identify opportunities for service expansion and retention
Create, update, and repurpose presentations, pitch decks, and supporting materials for client meetings
Maintain accurate records of client interactions, meeting notes, and follow-up activities
Coordinate communication across internal stakeholders using Microsoft Teams, email, phone, and messaging platforms
Ensure all client communications are professional, timely, and aligned with company standards
Work with the CFO to prepare and send proposals for existing and prospective clients
Maintain accurate client activities, contacts, and records within HubSpot

Must-Have Requirements

3+ years of experience in customer success, operations coordination, account management, executive support, or a similar client-facing role
Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
Strong client relationship management and communication abilities
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
Experience with or the ability to quickly learn HubSpot CRM, DotLoop, or similar electronic signature solutions
Experience creating professional presentations, reports, and business documents
Ability to manage multiple priorities while coordinating across teams and stakeholders
Comfortable communicating with clients via phone, email, text, and virtual meetings
Ability to work independently while maintaining accuracy and professionalism
Reliable internet connection and professional remote work environment

Nice-to-Have Requirements

Familiarity with IT terminology and technology-related environments
Experience using HubSpot CRM
Experience using DotLoop or similar electronic signature platforms
Experience working within the healthcare or cybersecurity industries




Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to become a key member of a growing healthcare cybersecurity company where your work will directly contribute to delivering an outstanding client experience. You'll serve as the central connection between clients and internal teams, helping ensure every interaction is organized, responsive, and professional while supporting meaningful, long-term client relationships.




As the company continues to grow, you'll have the opportunity to expand your responsibilities, collaborate closely with leadership, and make a visible impact on customer success operations. If you enjoy building relationships, coordinating moving pieces, and creating exceptional client experiences in a fast-paced environment, this role offers the chance to grow your career while contributing to a mission-driven organization dedicated to protecting healthcare organizations and the communities they serve.
