Continuous Enablement: Develop post-onboarding curricula that keep the team sharp on new feature releases, industry trends, and advanced account management strategies ; including expansion positioning from upselling and cross-selling 
Needs Assessment: Identify knowledge and skill gaps through data-driven assessments, aligning all training programs to revenue priorities and business objectives.
Blended Learning Delivery: Develop and deliver engaging learning experiences—including live workshops, virtual sessions, and eLearning—for global CS teams of all experience levels.
Tactical Content Creation: Build practical exercises, job aids, and visual guides that translate technical API capabilities and product updates into actionable "Success Plays."
Tools & Stack Mastery: Serve as the subject matter expert for the CS toolset (Gong, Salesforce andPlanhat,ensuring the team navigates our systems with speed and precision.
Strategic Partnership: Collaborate with CS Leadership to drive accountability and partner with Sales Enablement to ensure cohesive product and process updates across the revenue org.
Advocacy & Improvement: Serve as a trusted advisor and champion for continuous improvement in CS skills, processes, and training best practices.

 

What you’ll bring:

To be successful in this role, you should be a blend of an educator, a strategist, and a Customer Success advocate. We are looking for someone who understands that CS is both an art and a science. 

Required:

CS Enablement Background: 2–4 years of experience in Customer Success training and enablement. If you’ve previously carried a book of business as a CSM, that’s a major plus.
The "CS Lens" on Sales Process: A solid understanding of the B2B lifecycle. You understand how discovery, handoffs, and pipeline management directly impact long-term retention and expansion.
CS Tech Stack Power User: High proficiency in Salesforce and Planhat (or similar CS Platform such as Gainsight, Totango, Hubspot, Zendesk, and Churn Zero etc.). You are comfortable being the "go-to" expert who helps others navigate our tools with speed and precision.
Instructional Design Mastery: Experience creating clean, professional training materials, slide decks, and tutorials. Proficiency in Articulate (or similar authoring tools) is required to build our eLearning library.
Strong Facilitation Skills: You are a confident, engaging presenter who can break down complex API capabilities or process-heavy workflows into simple, actionable steps.

Experience we consider a plus:

Cross-Functional Collaborator: Ability to work effectively with Sales/CS Ops, Product Marketing, and CS Managers to ensure content is technically accurate and relevant to the field.
Detail-Oriented & Precise: A passion for accuracy and a "get it right" mindset when documenting internal processes and system workflows.
Strategic Advisor: A champion for continuous improvement who isn't afraid to identify skill gaps and propose creative solutions to fill them.
Methodology Knowledge: A background in MEDDPICC or similar sales/success methodologies is a significant advantage.
Where you will work:

This position offers a fully remote work arrangement based out of Mexico.

Sponsorship is not available. Legal authorization to work in Mexico is required. We are unable to sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. 

 

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice. 

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

About the job

Description

Amazon is looking for a talented, smart, experienced and enthusiastic Marketing Manager to help develop and grow our Category marketing business in Mexico. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in an exciting new team structure.

The successful candidate will develop strategies and managing the execution of acquisition, engagement and retention initiatives, primarily via online channels including push notifications, emails, onsite experience, SEO, internal search, affiliate marketing, social media and mobile.

Candidate is expected to improve key product features (Search, IDQ, Personalization, Fit, Detail Page, RCX...) by working cross-functionally across Emerging marketplaces stakeholders. You will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment, and able to think big while paying careful attention to detail.

Key job responsibilities

Main KPIs are: traffic, acquisition, customer active base, settlement and lapsed rates. Responsibilities:


 Lead site merchandising for all categories across MX - develop and execute merchandising activities, manage navigation structure, create pages and merchandising features to support coop initiatives, coordinate and support promotional events and marketing campaigns.
 Lead several programs for customer acquisition and engagement, partnering with several tech teams
 Work closely with the traffic teams to drive customers and sales to our store, including gateway, outbound, associates, search, social media.
 Design, lead and implement customer experience enhancement/improvement projects.
 Create and analyze performance metrics and making business decisions about future direction based on performance and ROI
 Partner with various technical and business teams to build supporting automation
 Own weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting of key content and marketing metrics to the leadership team and broader organization.


The ideal candidate will be innovative, team oriented, an effective communicator across functions and levels, have a desire to participate in change, and appreciate a highly entrepreneurial environment with rapidly changing priorities. We are seeking someone with proven track record in project and stakeholder management, deep analytical skills, and ability to simplify and scale.

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
 7+ years of developing and managing acquisition marketing or channel programs experience
 Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
 Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
 Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
 Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
 Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint

About the job

Company Description

Beauty Concept Brands is the female-founded, family-owned company behind Skin Gym and PaintLab. Based in Los Angeles, we create innovative beauty, wellness, and nail products that make self-care effective, accessible, and fun.




Skin Gym is an award-winning beauty and wellness brand known for innovative face and body tools inspired by ancient practices and modern technology. PaintLab is an award-winning press-on nail brand offering trend-forward, salon-quality designs for effortless at-home manicures.




Our brands have been featured in Vogue, Allure, ELLE, Harper’s Bazaar, Cosmopolitan, Nylon, and Byrdie and are distributed through major retailers, including Ulta Beauty, Walmart, CVS, Nordstrom, Macy’s, and Amazon.




Role Description

We are seeking a strategic, analytical, and hands-on Performance Marketing Manager to lead paid media and customer acquisition for Skin Gym and PaintLab.

This role will own performance across Meta, Google, TikTok, and other emerging digital channels. The ideal candidate can move seamlessly between strategy and execution—building campaigns, analyzing performance, testing creative, managing budgets, and identifying opportunities to scale profitably.

The Performance Marketing Manager will collaborate closely with our creative, social media, e-commerce, email, and brand teams to develop campaigns that drive new customer acquisition, revenue, and long-term growth across both brands.

Own paid media strategy and execution across Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, and other relevant channels.
Build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns for prospecting, retargeting, product launches, promotions, and evergreen products.
Manage budgets across two brands based on performance, growth targets, inventory, and promotional priorities.
Drive profitable customer acquisition while monitoring ROAS, MER, CAC, LTV, conversion rate, AOV, and contribution margin.

Partner with the creative and social teams to develop a consistent pipeline of performance-driven creative.

Establish a structured testing roadmap across creative concepts, messaging, offers, audiences, landing pages, and campaign formats.
Analyze performance by channel, campaign, product, audience, and creative asset.
Identify underperforming campaigns quickly and make timely, data-driven adjustments.
Improve tracking, attribution, reporting, and data accuracy across advertising platforms and Shopify.
Collaborate with the e-commerce team to improve landing pages, product pages, conversion rates, and the customer journey.
Coordinate paid media strategies with email, SMS, affiliate, creator, retail, and organic social initiatives.
Prepare weekly and monthly reports summarizing performance, insights, challenges, and next steps.
Build forecasts and recommend monthly budgets, revenue targets, and customer acquisition goals.
Stay current on platform changes, privacy updates, attribution models, creative trends, and emerging acquisition opportunities.




Qualifications
4+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience, preferably within beauty, wellness, fashion, or consumer products.
Well-versed in Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and LLM-driven search, with the ability to optimize brand content for visibility across AI-powered discovery platforms and emerging search experiences.
Proven experience managing and scaling campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads.

Join our top-notch team of more than 50,000 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.

You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have:

You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan.

And More: 

We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be – and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to:



Grow: Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths. 
Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal.

Give Back: Help us continue to make positive changes locally and globally through volunteerism, giving back, and sustainable business practices. 



What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us!

A genuine personal interest in tabletop gaming. 
Familiarity with gaming culture more broadly, including Kickstarter launches, conventions, and the communities around them.
Experience designing for niche or enthusiast audiences.
Creative writing abilities to take general concepts and add compelling copy

Deliver work reliably on quick timelines that support ongoing creative testing and iteration.

Direct exposure to a fast-moving, performance-driven creative team.

Job Title: Social Media Content Manager (Video Editing & Short-Form Content)

Sitting on a camera roll full of raw footage and know exactly how to turn it into content people actually stop and watch? This role hands you the keys to a brand's entire social presence right as it starts to scale.

This is a distilled spirits import and distribution company based in Texas, founded in 2025, that brings artisanal, handcrafted agave spirits to the U.S. market. The brand identity is rooted in something real: rural, cultural, handcrafted, and authentic, not luxury gloss. It's a lean, founder-led operation currently distributing one brand, with three more landing over the coming months and expansion into New York and California already underway.

This is the ground floor. You would be the person shaping how the brand shows up online, taking raw video and photos from events and tastings and turning them into scroll-stopping posts across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. The founder is hands-on and wants a real creative partner, someone scrappy who brings ideas to the table, not someone waiting to be told what to do. If you live on social media, know what makes content work, and want real ownership over a brand's growth from the start, this is your seat.




3.) Key Responsibilities

Edit raw video and photo content from events and tastings into polished, publish-ready posts using professional tools like Adobe Premiere or Final Cut Pro
Produce around 3 posts per week, primarily short-form video, across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok (with YouTube Shorts as a secondary channel)
Generate original content ideas, scripts, and creative angles to help the brand stand out
Direct the founder on the specific shots, footage, and content needed to bring ideas to life
Research competitor and influencer accounts to spot what's working and adapt winning strategies
Own content planning and stick to a consistent posting timeline
Join regular morning check-ins with the founder to align on daily tasks and priorities




4.) Must-Have Requirements

Proven experience managing social media content, ideally for a growing or small brand
Video editing proficiency with professional tools (Adobe Premiere, Final Cut Pro, or similar) beyond basic in-app editors
Strong working knowledge of Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok
Excellent written English for captions and content
A creative, self-directed thinker who can independently generate content ideas and ways to stand out
Portfolio of previous social media or video editing work




5.) Nice-to-Have Requirements

Familiarity with agave spirits or the broader beverage/spirits industry
Comfort researching and learning niche or specialty products independently
Experience working with small or founder-led brands




6.) Why Join Us

This is a chance to own a brand's entire social presence from the very beginning, not to be one voice among many, but the person who builds it. You would work directly with a founder who values initiative, creativity, and people who take real pride in their work over polished corporate types who just follow orders. The brand is growing fast, with new product launches and expansion into new states already in motion, so there's genuine room for this role to grow in scope as the business scales. If you want the freedom to experiment, throw out bold ideas, and actually see your work move the needle on a brand's growth, this is the kind of seat that lets you do it.

description:
About the job

Job Description

Join the LEGO Group as a Digital Merchandiser and help drive eCommerce growth across LATAM. In this role, you'll optimize product content, improve discoverability, and collaborate with top retailers to deliver an outstanding online shopping experience. It's a chance to make a real impact in a fast-paced, creative environment!


Core Responsibilities

e-Merchandising (50%)



Create, maintain, and optimize product content (images, copy, BTC content, video, etc.) based on performance metrics, SEO best practices, and other insights.  Monitor digital shelf quality for continual optimization of content – adhering to retailer requirements. 
Accountable for product launches at eCommerce retailers across LATAM – planning and implementing product launches with all applicable selling information and enhanced content. Bring forward ideas to improve this process. 
Work with customers to determine the most effective product categorization, taxonomy, and navigation structure to improve the online shopping experience. 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as Item Set Up, Account Leads, Marketing, Trade Marketing, and external partners. 
Use SEO tactics to improve product discoverability and search engine rankings. This includes ensuring titles, product bullets, product descriptions, and other copy elements are compelling, accurate, and incorporate relevant keywords to drive organic traffic and increase conversion rates. 
Act as a point of contact with eCommerce partners, agencies and others to facilitate content optimization and ensure consistency across platforms and systems. 


Digital Marketing (25%)



Support Digital Marketing activities with B2B customers, including content creation and management, follow up on implementation of paid campaigns, and support on data analysis for future improvements. 


Analysis (25%)



Generate detailed reports on eCommerce performance CST to identify opportunity for improvement. 
Carry out After Action Reviews for B2B Marketing Implementation with customers to help refine our digital spend. 
Conduct test and learns and regular shelf auditing to identify trends, actionable insights, and opportunities to improve the digital shelf. 


Play your part in our team succeeding

This is an opportunity to deliver a meaningful impact to the growth of the LEGO Group. The eCommerce team supports development of merchandising strategy, digital shelf improvement, and other digital merchandising activities for B2B eCommerce partners across LATAM to increase eCommerce sales.

As a Digital Merchandiser, you will contribute to the growth of the eCommerce business by providing digital merchandising support to our eCommerce retailers. This includes improving discoverability, online search rankings, conversion, and the overall shopper experience.

Do you have what it takes?



Hands-on experience in digital merchandising within eCommerce. 
Experience with consumer-packaged goods and/or children’s category is a plus! 
Outstanding writing and grammar abilities — copywriting experience preferred. 
Knowledge of Digital Marketing principles and basic understanding of demand generation in online platforms. 
Knowledge of SEO principles and the ability to create content with SEO in mind. 
Proficient in critical thinking, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving. 
Ability to work quickly and accurately in a fast-paced environment while still maintaining attention to detail and being resilient. 
Strong knowledge of MS Office with particular emphasis in Excel and Power Point. 
Self-starter who initiates and executes new ideas to improve the digital shelf. 
Fluent in English and Spanish; Portuguese a plus! 


Nice to have 



Retail eCommerce platforms experience – Familiarity with e-commerce platforms is a bonus! 
Team player – Curious, collaborative, and thrives in a team setting. 
Adaptable – Comfortable in a fast-changing environment. 


Additional Details On This Position



Our workplace enables our LEGO® colleagues to be and do their best at work. Introducing a flexible way of working through a hybrid working model is a great example of how we live up to our ambition. This 3 day in the office hybrid working model will exemplify our People Promise by embracing the different life situations of our colleagues.

About the job

Resumen

Bajo supervisión cercana, el Representante de Servicio al Cliente es responsable de cumplir con precisión los pedidos de los clientes y gestionar las llamadas.

Deberes De Trabajo


Responde a consultas básicas de los clientes sobre productos, proporciona cotizaciones y maneja el ingreso de pedidos. 
Realiza pedidos de clientes por teléfono, fax, correo electrónico, métodos electrónicos o sin cita previa (ventas de mostrador). 
Influye la rentabilidad de Motion Industries negociando el precio de venta y el precio de compra, dentro de ciertos parámetros. 
Puede ajustar los precios de los clientes sin contrato para satisfacer las demandas de estos mismos en función de la competencia, mientras maximiza las ganancias para Motion Industries. 
Construye relaciones con los clientes para la repetición de negocios relacionándose con el cliente y manejando mejoras en los procesos. 
Realiza pedidos de artículos para garantizar que se mantengan niveles de inventario adecuados para los clientes. 
Puede realizar pedidos sin aprobación para pedidos de hasta $5,000 USD por línea y $10,000 USD por orden de compra. 
Responsable del abastecimiento de productos en el inventario de sucursales, inventario de centros de distribución o inventario de proveedores. 
Determina el método de envío más rentable para los pedidos de los clientes. 
Se asocia con representantes de cuentas para garantizar la satisfacción del cliente. 
Acelera los pedidos pendientes. 
Puede extraer inventario y preparar el pedido para su envío al cliente. 
Puede encargarse de las devoluciones de los clientes. 
Realiza otras tareas que le sean asignadas. 


Educación y Experiencia


Se requiere una licenciatura y de uno (1) a tres (3) años de experiencia. Experiencia en la industria es preferible. 
Bilingüe: español/inglés. Nivel de inglés intermedio/avanzado (capacidad para comunicarse de forma fluida en conversaciones técnicas). 


Conocimientos y Habilidades


Se requiere confiabilidad, organización y atención al detalle. 
Fuertes habilidades de comunicación incluyendo escrita, verbal y auditiva. 
Capacidad para realizar múltiples tareas y habilidades de gestión del tiempo requeridas.
Habilidades informáticas moderadas, incluido el procesamiento de información, la comunicación interna y externa por correo electrónico, el uso de sistemas comerciales y capacidades de búsqueda para encontrar productos en Internet. 
Se prefiere el conocimiento del producto.

Motion Industries ofrece un excelente paquete de beneficios que incluye opciones de cobertura de gastos médicos mayores, dental, vacaciones, y pago de días festivos.

description:
About the job

Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About The Role

Dandy is hiring a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, Training to join our rapidly growing venture-backed company. The Revenue Operations team owns operationalizing our Revenue organization and driving efficiencies to help scale our Revenue. In this role, you’ll support and scale our Training Team, the group responsible for customer onboarding (“Activation”) and guiding customers through their first 30 days. This role will be critical in operationalizing all aspects of revenue operations for the training function, such as ensuring our teams have the processes, systems, insights, and incentives needed to drive customer success and revenue impact.

You will act as the RevOps partner to Training leadership, owning the operational backbone that enables consistent activations, faster time-to-value, and repeat customer ordering.

What You'll Do


Own end-to-end Revenue Operations support for the Training team, from contract signed through a customer’s first 30 days
Translate company-level revenue strategy into clear, executable operating plans for the Training team
Partner with Sales, Marketing, Training, and central RevOps to ensure alignment across the customer lifecycle
Design, refine, and automate workflows to drive efficiencies within the Training function
Build reporting and dashboards to provide clear visibility into customer lifecycle health and identify opportunities for improvement
Support a team that will be expanding internationally into a number of countries in the next 12 months
Partner closely with the Training team leadership to drive conversion improvements across the post sales funnel (Contract Signed to Customer Graduation)


What We're Looking For


6–8+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Operations, or related fields
Proven experience supporting customer onboarding, activation, or early lifecycle revenue motions
Strong understanding of CRM systems (Salesforce) and analytics tools (Looker, Hex)
Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into scalable processes
Exceptional analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Experience in high-growth, fast-paced environments preferred
Operates with urgency and ownership and is comfortable in ambiguous situations


For full-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

Dandy also fully complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals. If you require any accommodations for your interview or have any questions beforehand, rest assured that we will do everything we can to meet your needs. Visit Dandy Careers for more!

You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your data at any time by contacting Privacy Requests.

description:
About the job

Overview

CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity

This role sits within the newly established Process Excellence & Automation (PE&A) function under PepsiCo’s Strategy & Transformation organization and is responsible for embedding a strong culture of continuous improvement across Requisition to Pay (R2P) operations delivered from the Mexico Capability Centre. The role will lead Lean Six Sigma–based transformation, driving process simplification, standardisation, and operational excellence across the end-to-end R2P value stream. It will focus on improving efficiency, reducing cost to serve, enhancing user experience, and ensuring disciplined continuous improvement governance across all R2P teams in the Mexico Capability Centre. Key responsibilities include leading Kaizen events, Value Stream Mapping, and Design Thinking workshops, while partnering closely with Global Process Owners, Hyper Automation, and Digital teams to deliver scalable and sustainable improvements. This position reports into senior leadership within the Process Excellence & Automation organisation.

Your Impact

As Process Excellence - Manager your scope would consist of …


Build a Culture of Continuous Improvement 
Lead Lean Six Sigma capability building across R2P operational teams, including foundational, intermediate, and advanced training programs. 
Facilitate CI circles, ideation workshops, and best practice sharing sessions. 
Coach teams and individuals to identify waste, improve process flow, and sustain improvements. Process Diagnosis & Transformation 
Diagnose current-state R2P processes using process mining, Lean, Six Sigma, and data-driven analysis. 
Lead simplification and standardisation initiatives across the end-to-end R2P value stream. 
Identify and implement automation and digital solutions, including RPA, BPM, AI, and workflow tools. Portfolio, Governance & Value Realisation 
Own and manage the R2P CI project portfolio, ensuring alignment to business priorities, disciplined execution, and benefits realisation. 
Establish and run CI governance routines to review progress, surface risks, and identify support needs. 
Maintain project charters, benefit trackers, dashboards, and leadership performance reporting. Performance Management & Stakeholder Engagement 
Govern process performance through KPIs, SLAs, and process control frameworks. 
Ensure strong cross-functional collaboration to enable seamless execution of CI initiatives. 
Facilitate workshops, design sprints, and stakeholder steering committees. 
Support process transitions and stabilisation to ensure sustained performance. Key Success Metrics 
Cycle Time Improvement across the end-to-end R2P value stream 
Increase in Touchless Processing and adoption of automation and digital solutions 
Reduction in Rework, Process Variability, and Exceptions 
Productivity Gains and Validated Cost Savings delivered through CI initiatives 
Process Standardisation and Harmonisation across locations and business units 
Improved User Experience and Stakeholder Satisfaction 
CI Capability Uplift, measured through training participation, certifications, and strength of the improvement idea pipeline 


Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For?


10–15 years of experience driving Continuous Improvement and Operational Excellence across Finance & Accounting and Procurement within a global shared services environment (CPG experience preferred).
Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification (mandatory). 
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related discipline. 
Strong expertise in Requisition to Pay / Procure to Pay processes, controls, and compliance. 
Proven track record of leading cross-functional CI programs and delivering measurable business outcomes. 
Hands-on experience with automation, process and task mining, analytics, and digital workflow solutions. 
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and change management skills. 


If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

What can you expect from us: 


Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs. 
Internal digital platforms that promote self-learning. 
Development programs according to Leadership skills. 
Specialized training according to the role. 
Learning experiences with internal and external providers. 
We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others. 
Financial wellness programs that will help you reach your goals in all stages of life. 
A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle.
And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our Wellness Line, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others. 


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We respect and value diversity as a work force and innovation for the organization.

description:
About the job

Description

Amazon is looking for high-potential leaders, who are ready to own their impact in Amazon Operations as an entry-level manager. We promise you will have your leadership capacity stretched to its full potential. As a front-line leader, you will have an opportunity to truly invest in others and develop a people-focused leadership style, while mastering the tools, processes, and operations that have created the most customer-centric company on Earth. If you want to be involved in continuing to define the future of online retail, and are dynamic and an organized self-starter, come join our team as an Area Manager!

As an Area Manager, you will have the opportunity to lead and develop your own team of Amazon Associates in a sort center environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring and coaching your team. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.
